name: mcp-server-paperless
description: Search, read, file, tag and upload documents in your paperless-ngx 3.x archive, by name and with a confirmation step before anything final.

paperless_url.title: Paperless URL
paperless_url.description: Base URL of your paperless-ngx 3.x instance, e.g. https://paperless.example.org

paperless_token.title: Paperless API token
paperless_token.description: Create it in Paperless under your profile menu, My Profile. The server acts as this user

paperless_public_url.title: Public URL
paperless_public_url.description: Base URL for links shown to you, if it differs from the Paperless URL

paperless_mcp_toolsets.title: Toolsets
paperless_mcp_toolsets.description: Toolsets to offer, comma-separated, or all. Once set, must not be empty: type core,ai for the default

paperless_mcp_read_only.title: Read-only
paperless_mcp_read_only.description: Offer only tools that change nothing in Paperless

paperless_mcp_disabled_tools.title: Disabled tools
paperless_mcp_disabled_tools.description: Tools never offered, by name, comma-separated

paperless_mcp_upload_dirs.title: Upload directories
paperless_mcp_upload_dirs.description: Absolute directories the model may upload files from by path, comma-separated. Empty: none
